mechanism_definition.inherited_components: Target-aware category/brand history pooling with shared embeddings; aligned unit-normalized field products; scale_half_tangent product-channel backward rule; frozen histories, scratch training, mean BCE and Adam.
mechanism_definition.row_rule: From registered configurations and scoped prior records: G is the complete baseline shared-row gradient, P the guarded projected complete-row target. N uses G; magnitude uses G*||P||/||G|| on eligible rows; direction-only uses P*||G||/||P|| with inherited guards.
mechanism_definition.qualification: None disables only the complete-row intervention; it retains the modified product/backward backbone. Magnitude preserves raw complete-row direction in ideal arithmetic, not the Adam update direction or subsequent optimizer trajectory.

observations.statement: All 83 authorized trial receipts were resolved: 79 successes and four execution failures. Current runtime history and trajectory index agree with complete receipt status, AUC, source and wall fields where present. Every success scores the same-sized validation population.
Latest N reproduces aggregate AUC/Logloss and all 23 slice dictionaries from round24/25/26 none controls. Metric replay does not certify identical predictions or hidden states.

Schema6 reports 14,661 training calls through checkpoint. All six train gates at calls0/512/8192 report valid_gate=1. N intended-gradient relative error is zero; M errors range 6.323476872361075e-9 to 1.3791729716213043e-8. Scalar BCE, padding correction and outside-eligible correction checks report zero.

Latest raw-direction absolute error is at most 1.1920928955078125e-7. On 512 validation impressions, both report zero forward-reference discrepancy, masked mass and empty-summary norm; maximum attention-weight sum error is 1.7881393432617188e-7. All eight reported synthetic algebra checks are zero.

Latest pair has identical learned capacity: 17,130,275 total parameters (17,078,688 embedding; 51,587 dense). Receipt wall sum 1414.6968627274036 seconds and train sum 1234.00091509521 seconds. M uses more measured wall/train time and peak memory in this pair.

Round26 M gained only 0.000024328076400625953 AUC over N. Latest M loses; those are different source versions, not an identical-source replication. Both original source replay and within-source schema2/schema3 duplicates separately demonstrate unstable M performance.

Round26 candidate-owned same-state shadows report nonzero role aggregation repeat distances and tiny M gradient/moment differences at calls512/8192. A represented Adam update difference of 1.4901161193847656e-8 appears at512, while8192 is null. N updates/moments are null. Fixed-tree aggregation remains a shadow, never a full-training treatment.
Round25 early shadows at calls0/1 reported zero represented update differences despite gradient discrepancies. Preserve these nulls alongside the later512 positive and8192 null.

Static/pooled/target-aware reference AUCs are 0.6050036144838207/0.6102261137080656/0.6133619861190683. Full count correction loses in both backbones; half correction improves pooled AUC but loses target-aware AUC.

Field-aligned products locally outperform ordinary and crossed normalized products. Constant/history-mean controls nearly match fuller normalization. Combined half routing outperforms either isolated half route. Several representation and generic-conditioning explanations remain.

Direction-only, rotated-magnitude and uniform-energy variants lose AUC to their none comparators. These raw-gradient controls do not match actual Adam updates and cannot establish semantic conflict attribution.

Four trace-v1 jobs fail with the recorded float32/64 support error before validation. Their wall sum is21.4754219353199 seconds; null metrics and train costs are retained. These are execution failures, separate from successful model negatives.

Latest knowledge usage has status documented and no undocumented industry IDs. The two declared executed IDs, variants, source hashes and statuses agree with receipts. This verifies declaration-to-receipt provenance, not the scientific truth or causal value of knowledge.

interpretations.statement: The frozen magnitude implementation has a valid observed negative population comparison, conditional on host scorer and declared source isolation. Bounded correctness checks weaken an obvious disabled-intervention or gross padding/BCE-error explanation. They do not prove training-wide correctness.

interpretations.statement: No reproducible incremental magnitude advantage is established. Latest negative joins adverse exact-source and duplicate evidence; the original positive and round26 tiny positive remain valid observations.

interpretations.statement: The local numerical propagation claim remains supported only in the sampled candidate-owned shadows. The new performance loss neither proves nor refutes that aggregation variation causes the final-score drift.

The accumulated no-row backbone has stronger repeatability evidence than M and exceeds the original target-aware reference. This is evidence for the accumulated changes, not attribution to a single component or independent-seed generalization.

Coarse category/brand target-aware relevance and generic gradient conditioning remain plausible. Semantic conflict resolution, training-wide numerical repair, external-architecture transfer and literature novelty remain unverified.
